entities.name: UE capability transfer procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE compiles and transfers its UE capability information to the network upon receiving a UECapabilityEnquiry message.

entities.name: UECapabilityEnquiry
entities.description: Message sent by the network to request UE capability information from the UE.

entities.name: UECapabilityInformation
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to provide its capability information to the network in response to a UECapabilityEnquiry.

entities.name: UE capability information
entities.description: Information element containing the UE's radio access capabilities compiled by the UE.

relations.description: The UE capability transfer procedure is initiated when the UE receives a UECapabilityEnquiry message from the network.
The UE capability transfer procedure includes the UE sending a UECapabilityInformation message to the network.
The UECapabilityInformation message contains the UE capability information IE compiled by the UE.
